title: Monophasic ß-TCP vs. biphasic HA/ß-TCP in two-stage sinus floor augmentation procedures-a prospective randomized clinical trial. Jelušić D
authors: Zirk ML, Fienitz T, Plancak D, Puhar I, Rothamel D. Clin Oral Implants Res. 2017 Oct;28(10):e175-e183. doi: 10.1111/clr.12983.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Both monophasic and biphasic materials show good biocompatibility and osteoconductivity with satisfactory support on implant stability. BBS remains more stable in terms of volume maintenance and radiological graft homogeneity after a healing period of 6 months” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
